content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First

The mistake that almost every creator makes first is thinking that payment options like Stripe or PayPal are reliable and trustworthy. They assume that because these platforms are popular and well-established, they will always be available and functioning properly. Stripe and PayPal are not just payment processors - they are also commerce platforms that own and control your entire payment stack.
